judgment_calls: Block is a 12-tri sawn billet with slight top-vertex jitter for a rough-blank look; flat sharp edges distinguish it from rounded soap cakes.
Bead is a 6-sided drilled tube (48 tris) to meet budget; hex reads as a hand-faceted blank.
Gouge blade is a single-sided curved U strip (open profile) to save tris.
Textures are 64px noise-tinted BaseColor PNGs, not embedded or linked in FBX.
